roleContext.jobDescription: Quillstone sells endpoint-security subscriptions through about 60 account executives. Its Business Systems Analyst looks after the CRM and the quoting tool: gathering requirements from sales leadership, configuring approval workflows, taking approved changes through the IT change process into the live CRM and reporting on how the changes are used. The analyst also keeps the opportunity-field data dictionary current and presents adoption figures at the monthly sales leadership review. Requests reach the analyst through a ticket queue, and every change is recorded in the change log with a test record and a named approver.

requirements.text: Gathers and documents requirements from sales leadership for CRM changes.
Configures approval workflows in the CRM or quoting tool.
Has taken a configuration change through a change process into the live CRM and reported on its use after release.
Maintains a data dictionary for CRM fields.
Builds adoption dashboards and presents them at the monthly sales leadership review.

# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Business Systems Analyst, Sales Operations

## Experience

- Sales Systems Analyst at Harrowgate Data from June 2021 to May 2024; ran requirement workshops with the regional sales directors and turned the outcomes into user stories for discount-approval changes, each with acceptance criteria agreed with the directors before build.
- Configured a three-tier discount approval workflow in the quoting tool, sending quotes above 15% discount to the regional director and those above 30% to the finance director's office.
- Moved the discount approval workflow into the live CRM on 11 March 2024 under change request CR-2207, after testing in the full-copy sandbox, and monitored quote approval times for six weeks after release.
- Kept the opportunity-field data dictionary current, recording the owner, picklist values and reporting use of each of 140 fields, and circulated the monthly changes to the reporting team.
- Built a dashboard for the sales operations manager showing, by region, the share of quotes that passed through the new approval steps; the dashboard refreshed daily from CRM report data.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the post-implementation review for CR-2207, with the change-board approval date (6 March 2024), the release date (11 March 2024), the sandbox tests passed beforehand and the approval-time figures for the six weeks after release, signed off by the sales operations manager; an appendix lists two minor defects found after release and their fixes.
